detail: Course must have grade C or higher (C- and below → no credit).
Transfer courses do not earn BU Hub general-education units.
All credits must be transferred within one year of starting at BU.
External grades do not count toward the BU GPA.
CAS CS 320, 332, 350 cannot be transferred; elective credit at most.
Max 4 Economics courses at 200+ level transferred after matriculation.
At least 5 BI courses beyond BI 107/108 must be taken at BU.
MA 242 may substitute for CS 132; MA 294 for CS 235; MA 581 for CS 237; MA 115/MA 213/QM 221 for EC 203.
Academic department evaluators make the final decision; the tool only suggests.
Pending credit shows as 0 units in MyBU Student until evaluated.
